authoring.ruleDeclarationPolicy: Only retired-table destination declarations absent from the RFC table list use source=rule-declaration. All preservation and projection rules are authored from the RFC and frozen SQL column declarations.
authoring.currentMeaning: Frozen epoch-1 chain after missing migrations, before conversion; seeds from later migrations are NOT injected during an older release upgrade.
authoring.preUpgradeMeaning: Actual release snapshot before frozen-chain completion. Absent tables do not require rows or dispositions.
authoring.historyOnlyMeaning: Explicit restricted NodeRun history with evidence; code-history packages instead use archived disposition.
authoring.codecEquality: Normalize database integer/boolean/timestamp/bytes representation using declared codecs; JSON/text content and hashing inputs retain exact original bytes.
